title: Terry Tao Links Unforced Navier–Stokes Singularities to the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
summary: Terry Tao has published a blog post, dated November 20, titled "Unforced Euler Singularity, Unforced Navier–Stokes Singularity, and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis," connecting unforced singularity constructions in the Euler and Navier–Stokes equations with the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis. The supplied material includes only the title and URL, not the post body, so the precise statement, whether a new theorem is claimed, and how the two subjects are linked cannot be confirmed here. The Hacker News thread treated the post as consequential and focused on formal proof verification and on what AI-driven proof generation means for mathematical research.
